section_summary.extract_value: This section describes procedure for a single study (referred to as "this study") involving women participants who could complete the survey either online or via traditional pen-and-paper; the online option used FluidSurveys (a Canadian web-based service). Participants were given an information letter, could withdraw at any time, were not compensated, and the study received university ethics approval.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants were offered the option of completing the study online or in the traditional pen-and-paper format. If interested in the online option, women were provided access to the contents of the study through FluidSurveys, a Canadian Webbased service allowing users to create and publish secure Internet surveys. Participants were not compensated for their participation in this study. This study was formally reviewed and approved by the researchers' university Ethics Review Board.
